scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs && node scripts/embed-assets.mjs
scripts.check: npm run bundle:worker && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.db:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply uchino-staging --remote --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --keep-vars
scripts.deploy:staging:initial: npm run check && npm run setup:staging && npm run db:staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --keep-vars
scripts.db:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply uchino --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --keep-vars
